tank_description: A fast and agile marksman armed with a highly accurate APHE auto-cannon, capable of delivering consistent damage at range. Equipped with anti-tank mines and a HE ATGM, the Marder 1A3 excels at controlling the battlefield and punishing unsuspecting enemies.

strengths.title: Good Mobility
strengths.description: The Marder is a highly nimble vehicle, able to traverse the battlefield with ease thanks to its respectable top speed. Its mobility allows it to quickly take up advantageous positions, set up ambushes, and use its powerful mines and missiles to disrupt enemy movements.

strengths.title: Area Denial
strengths.description: The Marder provides effective area denial through its deployable, motion-triggered mines. Best used along approaches to bases or through narrow urban streets, a well-placed mine can provide early warning of enemy movement while also disrupting or halting a push long enough for your team to capitalise.

weaknesses.title: Low Sustained Damage
weaknesses.description: Outside of its HE ATGMs and mines, the Marder relies solely on an APHE autocannon. While effective at applying sustained pressure during engagements, it delivers relatively little direct damage, particularly against heavily armoured targets. To compensate, players must actively seek flanking opportunities, crit zones, and lighter targets to maximise their damage output.

weaknesses.title: Low Survivability
weaknesses.description: The Marder is highly vulnerable to return fire. Its limited armour and easily accessible critical components mean it can be destroyed quickly when caught under direct fire. It is particularly susceptible to HE attacks from the side, which can potentially destroy the vehicle in a single shot.

tank_summary: The Marder 1A3 is a fast and highly responsive marksman that excels at delivering consistent damage from a safe distance. Armed with an APHE auto-cannon featuring the best aim speed in the game, it can quickly acquire targets and steadily chip away at enemy vehicles. While its individual shots may not be devastating, it's enough to maintain constant pressure throughout an engagement.

One of the Marder's most dangerous tools is its anti-tank mines. These can be placed in unexpected locations to deny routes, protect flanks, or punish aggressive pushes. Vehicles lacking shields or explosive reactive armour are especially vulnerable, often taking severe damage if they trigger a well-positioned mine. Commanders who learn common travel routes can really hinder the enemy.

As a secondary armament, the Marder carries a HE ATGM capable of dealing respectable burst damage or disrupting enemy movements. Used to finish off weakened targets or surprise distracted enemies, the missile adds versatility to an already capable vehicle. Combined with its mobility and excellent gun handling, the Marder 1A3 rewards patient players who can maintain distance and capitalize on enemy mistakes.
